scope: Read-only validation of the selected GTK2 theme configuration and installed scrollbar-stepper RC before further GTK2 work.

result.interpretation: The installed RC is a generated palette variant; the palette generator validates the published source manifest, then emits palette-specific GTK2 data. Do not interpret the runtime hash difference alone as stale installation.

method: Read-only inspection of ~/.gtkrc-2.0, installed GTK2 RCs/manifests, current repository sources, and the palette generator contract. No settings, windows, applications, VM, or files outside the new receipt and review queue were changed.
limits: This confirms selected configuration and RC contents only; it does not prove a GTK2 window reloaded them or visually matches SR10.4/VUE.
It does not resolve the missing cursor-clear horizontal held VUE reference or human review.
